reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
alternatives: SELECT s.store_code, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(l.line_discount_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur FROM stores s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1

SELECT s.store_code, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id RIGHT JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY s.store_code

SELECT s.store_code, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur), 0) AS revenue_eur
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00'
LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
